intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: Miguel is an IT expert with over a decade of experience across the DACH region, specializing in technical consulting, cloud strategy, and infrastructure modernization. His work bridges business requirements and technical architecture, with a strong focus on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes, enterprise database platforms, and secure multi-cloud environments.

experiences.role: Senior Account Cloud Engineer / Senior Technical Solutions Engineer
achievements: Acts as a trusted advisor for customers, working with pre-sales managers, cloud architects, and subject matter experts to understand customer objectives and shape cloud-native enterprise solutions on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
Designs technical architectures and supports adoption, optimization, and governance for OCI, Oracle Database Services, Oracle Autonomous AI Database, and Kubernetes Engine.
Previously served as Technical Solutions Engineer for database platforms in the DACH region, providing on-premises, hybrid, and cloud technology solutions.
Delivered enterprise cloud solutions and secure landing zones aligned with BSI IT-Grundschutz and BSI C5 standards, including work with AWS Landing Zone Accelerator.
Built architectural documentation, runbooks, playbooks, CI/CD pipelines, and Cloud FinOps reporting with Txture to support cloud operations and cost transparency.
Collaborated in international agile environments on cloud-native applications and infrastructure modernization for automotive sector clients.

experiences.company: Data Center for the Humanities DCH, University of Cologne, Germany

Supported machine-learning experiments for recognizing phenomena that can reduce manual annotation effort in large AV datasets.

projects.title: Oracle Cloud Advisory for Enterprise Customers
projects.summary: Trusted-advisor work shaping OCI adoption, optimization, governance, and enterprise database platform strategy.
projects.content:
## Overview

As a Senior Account Cloud Engineer at Oracle in Amsterdam, Miguel works with pre-sales managers, cloud architects, and subject matter experts to understand customer objectives and translate them into technical cloud strategies.

## Focus Areas

- **OCI architecture**: Customer guidance for adopting, optimizing, and governing cloud-native enterprise solutions on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
- **Business value**: Clear technical vision, scalability models, assessments, and architectures that connect cloud capabilities to customer outcomes.
- **Enterprise data platforms**: Advisory across Oracle Database Services, Oracle Autonomous AI Database, Oracle Database, RAC, and GoldenGate.
- **Cloud native platforms**: Work involving Kubernetes Engine on OCI and container-based enterprise solutions.

projects.title: Secure Cloud Landing Zones and Multi-Cloud Modernization
projects.summary: Deloitte cloud consulting work across secure landing zones, DevSecOps, Cloud FinOps, and multi-cloud infrastructure modernization.
projects.content:
## Overview

At Deloitte Consulting GmbH, Miguel worked in the Cloud Transformation & Systems Engineering practice on enterprise cloud solutions and infrastructure modernization for customers in the DACH region.

## Focus Areas

- **Secure landing zones**: Designed and delivered landing zones aligned with BSI IT-Grundschutz and BSI C5 standards.
- **Sovereign cloud proof of concept**: Partnered with AWS and Landing Zone Accelerator teams on a public-sector proof of concept incorporating confidential computing.
- **Operational documentation**: Created architecture documentation, runbooks, and playbooks to standardize cloud operations.
- **DevSecOps and FinOps**: Built CI/CD pipelines and implemented Cloud FinOps reporting with Txture to support cost transparency and operational control.
- **Team enablement**: Supported nearshore onboarding and introduced low-code automation to streamline landing zone deployment.
